Status

Blocked — ungated-integration, escalating as technical-blocker.

docs/hub/OWNER-VIEW-SPEC.md and docs/hub/BRANCH-REWRITE-RECORD.md were integrated to dev via PR #423 (merge 3695e26f) and PR #432 (merge 9cd09b0b) while this capsule read assigned. No candidate was frozen and no QA verdict exists; the freeze was deliberately withheld pending an it-manager-iii disposition ruling after PR #401 shipped renderHubSite (#427, #396). Requires the retrospective ruling on #468 plus that disposition ruling. Supersedes the prior evidence-loss blocker: its substance (the committed Hub is unrebuildable build output that has drifted from the control plane) is preserved in the integrated docs and in this ticket’s event chain, and the opsctl hub renderer now addresses regeneration.
